findings.note: Nov 15, 2026 RotoWire note: Stutzle scored a goal on 4 shots in a 4-1 win at Pittsburgh and has 25 points (11 G) in 21 games. It does not mention any injury. No report on injuries, lineups, goalies or analyst picks for this Jets game turned up.

RotoWire notes say Stutzle leads Ottawa's offense from the top line and first power-play unit. He got on the scoresheet in all but two of Ottawa's first 12 games. His four-game point streak ended in Vegas in late October, so he does sometimes go without a point.

Game log shows points in 4 of his last 5 games. He went pointless on 1 shot in a Nov 10 OT loss to Washington. He has 4 points in 6 November games (21:56 TOI), cooler than his October pace. On the road he has 16 points in 11 games.
